data.title: Make your first *project*
data.subtitle: One workspace per ongoing piece of work.

rows.label: + New Project
rows.detail: Upper right. Name and description are for you only

rows.label: Project knowledge
rows.detail: On the right: click + to upload files

rows.label: Set project instructions
rows.detail: How Claude should work here, then Save instructions

steps: Click **Projects** on the left, or go to **claude.ai/projects**
Click **+ New Project**, then add a name
Click **+** under project knowledge to add files
data.note: Drawn from Anthropic's help pages, not a screenshot. Chats in a project share only its knowledge and instructions. Free accounts can make up to five projects.
